note: SSOT for the manager tier ladder. `ladder` maps rung names to the model value the resolver emits, ordered STRONGEST FIRST. Rank comes from key order, never from code. Values are the Agent tool's model ALIASES, not full ids: the tool's schema is an enum (sonnet/opus/haiku/fable) and a full id fails validation before the spawn runs. `classes` maps each agent class to a capability tier. The overridable rest, `manager.tiers` (capability tier to ladder rung), `manager.mode` and `manager.enabled`, has its defaults in defaults/settings.json, under the machine's and the repo's settings files: `mode` 'rewrite' = the manager/resolver hook rewrites the spawn's model via updatedInput; 'advise' = the resolver blocks naming the required model (fallback for versions where updatedInput is not honored). Consumers: hooks/mods/resolver.js, hooks/mods/profile.js; tests override the path via MANAGER_LADDER. New model family = one ladder line here PLUS a family in modelTier in hooks/mods/manager.js (the family matcher every consumer uses); rung names must stay equal to family names or the profile's tier comparison breaks. The ladder sets models only: effort lives in each agent file's `effort:` frontmatter line (agents/<name>.md).
